Meet the Heart Behind Reign Roofing About the Owner: Zev Bailey Reign Roofing and Construction is more than just a business. It reflects Zev Bailey’s deepest values. Guided by his relationship with the Lord and his unwavering commitment to family, Zev has dedicated over five years to serving Texas homeowners with honesty, integrity, and expertise. For Zev, roofing is not just a job. It’s about advocating for homeowners and ensuring they get the protection they deserve. Every promise Reign Roofing makes is backed by action. Integrity is not just a word—it’s the foundation of everything we do. We earn your trust, provide exceptional customer service, and aim to be the shield that protects you during life’s storms. As Zev says, “Your roof, our reputation.” The work we leave behind is a testament to our commitment to building a huge family across Texas. Why Choose Reign Roofing & Construction Family is at Our Core We don’t just serve customers; we welcome you into our family. Your home gets the same attention, care, and respect as ours. Faith as Our Foundation Guided by our relationship with the Lord, we operate with integrity, honesty, and a commitment to serving others. We keep our promises, period. Honesty isn’t just a policy — it’s our way of life. When we say we’ll protect your home, we mean it. Texas-Tough Roofing Solutions We understand Texas weather and build roofs that are ready for anything. From scorching summers to stormy seasons, we’ve got you covered. Peace of Mind with Our 5-Year Warranty Enjoy complete confidence with our transferable 5-year workmanship warranty. Whether you’re staying or selling, your roof’s quality is guaranteed. One-Stop, Comprehensive Home Solutions From roofing to gutters, painting to pergolas – our expertise covers all your home needs. We’re here to simplify your life with full-service excellence. What REIGN Stands For R Reliability E Excellence I Integrity G God-Centered N Neighborly Care You Deserve a Roofer Who Actually Cares Most homeowners in Texas don’t realize how easy it is to end up with the wrong contractor. In our state, roofing doesn’t require a license – and that opens the door to inexperience, rushed work, and jobs that fall apart far too soon. We’ve seen it all: families who paid too much for low-quality repairs… roofs installed without proper ventilation for Texas heat… storm damage left unhandled because no one explained the insurance process properly. At Reign Roofing and Construction, we started this company because we were tired of seeing good people get taken advantage of. You shouldn’t have to chase your contractor, second-guess their advice, or wonder if the job was done right. We believe in honest work, clear communication, and building roofs that last – because that’s what we’d want for our own families. If you’ve had a bad experience in the past, we understand. That’s exactly why we do things differently. Whether it’s a hurricane, hailstorm, or Read More... Every Home We Work On Is Treated Our Family Lives There In Plano, McKinney, Dallas, Wylie, and beyond – homes face a lot. The hailstorms. The relentless heat. The confusion of insurance claims. It’s easy to feel overwhelmed when all you want is a roof that’s safe, solid, and built to last. And when roofing contractors treat your home like just another job, the stress only multiplies. That’s why we believe every homeowner deserves to be treated like family with honesty, care, and real attention to detail. Because a roof isn’t just a structure, it protects the people you love. So when you’re navigating storm damage, unexpected leaks, or a roof that just feels too far gone, you don’t have to figure it out alone. You’ll be treated with the same respect, care, and dedication we’d show our own. That’s what it means to be part of the Reign Roofing family. Your Roofing Questions , Answered 1. Do you offer emergency roofing services? Reign Roofing provides 24/7 emergency roofing services to handle unexpected situations like storm damage, severe leaks, or other urgent roofing issues. Our team is always on standby to protect your home and make immediate repairs to minimize further damage. 2. What is your 5-year transferable workmanship warranty? We offer a 5-year transferable workmanship warranty on all new roof installations. If you need to sell your home during this period and the new buyer requests a new roof, don’t worry. This warranty can be easily transferred, giving peace of mind to the new homeowner. Just call us to notify us of the new owner, and they’ll be covered for the remaining years. 3. What does the annual roof assessment include under the warranty? As part of our 5-year warranty, we conduct annual assessments to catch any potential issues before they become problems. This includes caulking and sealing nails and vents, repainting pipe jacks and exhaust caps, and ensuring your roof remains in excellent condition. 4. How do I know if my roof needs to be repaired or replaced? Our experts conduct a detailed roof inspection, documenting damage and providing an honest assessment. We explain whether a simple repair is sufficient or a full replacement is necessary. 5. Are you insured? Yes, we are fully insured to perform roofing services in the state of Texas. Our experienced crew adheres to all safety regulations to ensure a smooth and secure roofing process. 6. Does Reign Roofing assist with insurance claims? Absolutely! We help you every step of the way, from filing the claim to meeting with the insurance adjuster. Our goal is to make sure you receive fair coverage. 7. How often should I have my roof inspected? We recommend having your roof inspected at least once a year, preferably in the spring or fall, or immediately after any major wind or hail storms. Regular maintenance and inspections help identify potential issues before they escalate, prolonging the lifespan of your roof and preventing costly repairs. data.summary: The data presents significant red flags for review authenticity. A perfect 5.0 rating across 129 Google reviews for a roofing contractor founded in 2024 is highly unusual and suggests potential review manipulation or solicitation. The lack of any critical feedback, combined with the company's newness, makes the perfect score statistically improbable. The BBB 'A' rating reflects accreditation and complaint handling (with no complaints shown), not service quality. Without access to the actual review text content, the authenticity of the customer experiences cannot be verified, but the numerical pattern itself is a strong fake signal.
fake_signals: No negative or neutral reviews found
Company is very new (2024) with high volume of perfect reviews
No substantive review content provided for analysis
authentic_signals: Specific business name and contact info
data.discrepancy_explanation: A perfect 5.0 Google rating with 129 reviews is statistically improbable for any service business and suggests review manipulation. The BBB rating is based on accreditation and complaint handling, not customer reviews, and the company is very new (founded 2024). The lack of any negative or even neutral reviews on Google is a major red flag.
